messages:
maya (perf): Quick ask — can we lock a 45m slot next week for an inference performance review? I want to show updated p50/p95, cost/unit change, and a short KV-cache demo.
ashley (pm): +1. Mid-week preferred by product. Wed/Thu usually best. :calendar:
tom (eng-ml): Thu morning PT works for me. Wed I'm tied up with a customer deep-dive.
li (infra): I can do Thu or Fri. If we're demoing on Dedicated, I need to provision access ahead of time. Thu 10-11 PT is open for me.
maya (perf): Proposed: Thu 10:15-11:00 PT. Agenda draft below — edit or add bullets.
```agenda
- 5m: goals & context (maya)
- 15m: benchmark readout (p50/p95/p999, cost per 1k tokens) + dashboard tour (tom)
- 15m: KV-cache demo + throughput/latency tradeoffs (li)
- 10m: triage & rollout criteria (ashley + group)
```
maya (perf): Dashboard: https://redwood-infer.internal/dashboards/infer-perf — please paste any failing prompt sets into this thread before EOD Wed.
ashley (pm): Can we add decision thresholds for rolling to Dedicated? I want explicit p95 and cost-delta numbers we can gate on.
li (infra): I'll run a quick smoke on Dedicated with the current quant flags and post results:
```
./bench/run --model=redwood-1.4b --seq=1024 --batch=8 --quant=8bit
```
li (infra): Also will create a temporary test user for demo access and share creds in the invite (we can rotate after).
tom (eng-ml): On local infra I saw ~12% p95 improvement and ~6% cost reduction after the KV change; will bring a slide with full split by seq len.
maya (perf): RSVP: react with \u2705 for Thu 10:15-11, \u23f3 if you prefer Fri same time, or comment if neither works.
devbot: calendar invite draft created -> https://calendar.google.com/invite?event=perf-review-1942100420
sre-oncall: Please open an escalation channel for the demo. I recommend pinging #eng-oncall 10m before start and keeping the on-call phone on.
ashley (pm): \u2705
tom (eng-ml): \u2705
li (infra): \u2705 — will post the Dedicated smoke output by Wed EOD.
maya (perf): Thanks — I'll post the final slides and the deck link by Wed EOD and include the decision criteria Ashley asked for.
ashley (pm): Also adding a slot in the doc for "rollout plan": canary %, rollback criteria, monitoring signals.
maya (perf): Noted. If anyone has lightweight test prompts showing regressions, drop them here so we can include in triage.
li (infra): FYI running nightly perf job with new kernel selection tomorrow; results may influence the numbers I share.
maya (perf): Great. Final note: if you can't make it live, please leave comments in the deck or mark "watching recording" in the invite so we can capture feedback asynchronously.
